completion_requirements: same case specialization, threads, groups, chains, batch, shapes, layouts and WGMMA completion waits
fresh accumulators and cudaMemset poison output/stamps before each target launch; no custom auxiliary kernel
CUDA launch and completion event synchronization succeed before checking outputs
all launched CTA stamp entries overwritten and all declared output elements checked
short globaltimer/clock64 intervals and all-SM coverage are not acceptance criteria
stop after first CUDA, completion or numerical failure and emit partial failed validation when possible

declared_output_check.method: all logical matrix outputs via independent integer/dyadic host reference
declared_output_check.poison: all output double bytes=0xff before launch; NaN/Inf or any mismatch rejected

profiles.output_evidence_limit: all outputs are compared but values are not persisted; this evidence cannot support offline rechecking with a changed reference
profiles.kernel_symbol_convention: unmangled lp_{path}_{input_type}_g{groups}, bound to the actual target symbol by B2 SASS review
